scripts.docker:prune: docker compose down -v --rmi all --remove-orphans && docker volume prune -f
scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -n "wallet,game,front" -c "blue,green,magenta" "bun --filter @crash/wallets dev" "bun --filter @crash/games dev" "bun --filter frontend dev"
scripts.dev:npm: concurrently -n "wallet,game,front" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w services/wallet-service" "npm run dev -w services/game-service" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start:all: bun run docker:up && sleep 5 && bun run dev
